title: 第6课 · 你怎么不吃了
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 6 — 你怎么不吃了 · Why don't you eat more

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在学校 — In the school

items.zh: A：你知道小王今天什么时候来学校吗？
items.py: A: Nǐ zhīdào Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān shénme shíhou lái xuéxiào ma?
items.en: A: Do you know when Xiao Wang will come to school today?

items.py: B: Tā yǐjīng lái le.
items.en: B: He's already here.

items.py: A: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào tā lái le?
items.en: A: How do you know?

items.zh: B：我在门外看见他的自行车了。
items.py: B: Wǒ zài mén wài kànjiàn tā de zìxíngchē le.
items.en: B: I saw his bike outside the door.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在饭馆 — In a restaurant

items.zh: A：今天的羊肉很好吃，你怎么不吃了？
items.py: A: Jīntiān de yángròu hěn hǎochī, nǐ zěnme bù chī le?
items.en: A: The mutton is great today. Why have you stopped eating?

items.zh: B：这个星期天天都吃羊肉，不想吃了。
items.py: B: Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu, bù xiǎng chī le.
items.en: B: I've had mutton every day this week, I don't want any more.

items.py: A: Nà nǐ hái xiǎng chī shénme?
items.en: A: What would you like then?

items.py: B: Lái yìdiǎnr miàntiáo ba.
items.en: B: Some noodles, please.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在健身房 — In the gym

items.zh: A：昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球？
items.py: A: Zuótiān nǐmen zěnme dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?
items.en: A: Why didn't any of you play basketball yesterday?

items.zh: B：因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去。我去游泳了。
items.py: B: Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù. Wǒ qù yóu yǒng le.
items.en: B: It rained, so none of us went. I went swimming.

items.py: A: Nǐ jīngcháng yóu yǒng ma?
items.en: A: Do you swim often?

items.zh: B：这个月我天天游泳，我现在七十公斤了。
items.py: B: Zhège yuè wǒ tiāntiān yóu yǒng, wǒ xiànzài qīshí gōngjīn le.
items.en: B: I've swum every day this month. I weigh 70 kilos now.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在办公室 — In the office

items.zh: A：这两天怎么没看见小张？
items.py: A: Zhè liǎng tiān zěnme méi kànjiàn Xiǎo Zhāng?
items.en: A: How come I haven't seen Xiao Zhang these last few days?

items.py: B: Tā qù Běijīng le.
items.en: B: He's gone to Beijing.

items.py: A: Qù Běijīng le? Shì qù lǚyóu ma?
items.en: A: To Beijing? On holiday?

items.zh: B：不是，听说是去看他姐姐。
items.py: B: Bú shì, tīngshuō shì qù kàn tā jiějie.
items.en: B: No, I hear he's visiting his elder sister.

items.zh: 昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球？

items.zh: 这个星期我天天都吃羊肉。
items.py: Zhège xīngqī wǒ tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu.

items.en: She was ill, so she didn't go to school.

items.zh: 因为他每天跑步，所以身体很好。

items.en: He runs every day, so he's very healthy.

items.zh: 因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去。
items.py: Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù.
items.en: It rained yesterday, so none of us went.

items.py: Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān lái xuéxiào le ma?

items.en: Did he see Xiao Wang?

items.zh: 为什么他今天不想吃羊肉？
items.py: Wèi shénme tā jīntiān bù xiǎng chī yángròu?
items.en: Why doesn't he want mutton today?

items.zh: 为什么昨天他们都没去打篮球？
items.py: Wèi shénme zuótiān tāmen dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?
items.en: Why did none of them play basketball yesterday?
